nodes.label: Veo Generation
nodes.rationale: Veo 3.1 full gives cleaner hands than fast; neither preserves flat white backgrounds so a border flood-fill salvage restores them, keeping enclosed internal outlines intact.

nodes.label: Transparent WebP Switch
nodes.rationale: MP4 has no alpha channel so animations showed a white box; transparent animated WebP won over APNG on size, and the ancestor drop-shadow freeze theory was debunked by CDP pixel-delta test with the real bug being isPressed gating.

nodes.label: Animation Wiring Gotchas
nodes.rationale: Visibility decoupled from press state so quick taps still play a full cycle; img has no ended event so cycle completion is timer-based via animationDuration; each press remounts to replay from frame 0.

hyperedges.label: Button animation: Veo generation, transparent WebP, board wiring
